department: B.Tech - Artificial Intelligence and Data Science / CS&BS
textbook: Data and Information Security by Vilas S. Bagad & Iresh A. Dhotre (Technical Publications)

units.title: INTRODUCTION
topics: The Security Systems Development Life Cycle (SecSDLC)

units.title: SECURITY INVESTIGATION
topics: Threats and Attacks (Deliberate Software Attacks, Quality of Service Deviations)
Legal, Ethical and Professional Issues in Computer Security

units.title: DIGITAL SIGNATURE AND AUTHENTICATION
topics: Digital Signature Schemes and their Variants (Direct and Arbitrated Digital Signatures)
Authentication Protocols (One-Way, Mutual Authentication, Shared Secret, Public Key)
Authentication Requirements and Functions (MAC, Hash Functions, SHA-512, HMAC, CMAC)
Authentication Applications - Kerberos (V4 & V5, Realms, Tickets)
X.509 Directory Authentication Services and Public Key Certificates

units.title: E-MAIL AND IP SECURITY
topics: Pretty Good Privacy (PGP) - Operation, Key Rings, Message Formats, PGP Generation & Reception
PGP Concept of Trust and Trust Processing
S/MIME (MIME headers, functionality, cryptographic algorithms, certificates)
Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) and Authentication Header (AH) Protocols
IPSec Modes (Transport Mode vs. Tunnel Mode)
Security Association (SA), SA Parameters and Combining SAs

units.title: WEB SECURITY
topics: Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) - Objectives, Architecture and Protocol Stack
SSL Record Protocol and SSL Handshake Protocol
SSL Secure Communication (Alert and Change Cipher Spec Protocols)
Transport Layer Security (TLS) - Working and Comparison with SSL
Secure Electronic Transaction (SET) - Objectives, Participants and Entities
Dual Signature - Concept, Generation and Verification
SET Transaction Processing (Purchase Request, Payment Authorization, Payment Capture)
